svg.text: Query Transformation · Time Alignment · Parallel Retrieval · Post-Assembly · Governed Payload
Converts natural-language queries into guardrail-safe retrieval controls. Falls back to deterministic synthesis on LLM failure.
+ optional structured input (BuilderQueryContract) merged before guardrails
Classifies query into one of three retrieval routes:
Defaults to hybrid_both on classification failure
LLM extracts: tickers · metrics · time window · source types
Fallback: regex extraction if LLM unavailable
Dense input: semantic paragraph · Sparse input: rerank query
1. Ticker allowlist — unknown tickers removed, classified in-scope / out-of-scope
2. Time window fallback — missing or invalid window defaults to last 6 months
3. Ticker cap — excess tickers truncated to keep only the first N allowed
4. HyDE fallback — empty LLM paragraph replaced with deterministic synthesis
5. News rerank fallback — short query replaced with expanded news context
deterministic output regardless of LLM phrasing
Canonical news topic mapping and financial narrative profile resolution
Produces: topic vector · rerank query · posture metrics · read profile
Translates one human time window into per-source physical predicates (epoch_s for Qdrant · date range for DuckDB)
EVENT: news ≥1d · SEC ≥3d | MONTHLY: GPR ≥35d | DAILY: options ≥3d · macro ≥3d
Non-business anchors → previous business day · Min floor: 1d – 35d by cadence
Determines which lanes run as primary vs. hedge. Compensation for novel tickers runs after primary lanes complete.
Gold + Silver run fully in parallel
HyDE compensation: runs for novel tickers
D. Silver Retrieval — DuckDB over Parquet
Deterministic numeric truth. Never embedded into vectors.
Note: max 5 tickers per run — excess logged as TICKER_CAP audit event
Metric Dispatch — whitelist-constrained, per-source time predicates
put_call_ratio → PCR volume · open interest · status
options_analysis → ATM IV · IV rank · IV skew · OTM put IV · OTM call IV
liquidity → daily volume · open interest · avg spread · liquid contracts
Per-metric typed keys: PCR · IVRANK · IVSKEW · LIQ · PX · MACRO · GPR
Numeric values · lineage anchors · citation_contract (anchor + timestamp per metric)
E. Gold Retrieval — Qdrant Hybrid Semantic Search
Semantic evidence: news narratives · SEC filings · GPR reports
Note: SEC form queries run a direct lookup before vector search — returns early if found
RRF Fusion → CrossEncoder Rerank (score threshold applied)
News: soft ticker filter → topic-only at 180 days (broad ETFs use topic-indexed filters)
SEC / GPR / Mixed: strict ticker → soft → drop ticker → date post-filter (SEC)
Supplemental News — optional, ticker-free thematic retrieval
Independent timeout · appended when Gold news coverage is insufficient
G. Post-Retrieval Assembly — Governed AgentState Payload
Sequential steps after all lanes complete. Produces the immutable evidence envelope for the multi-agent pipeline.
Appends macro series + GPR to Silver
Ensures stable regime context after route
Immutable Silver copy for Checker audit
Locked before rescue. No numeric drift.
Records hits, misses, and fallbacks fired
intent · metadata · time_range · gold_context · silver_context · silver_context_frozen
Retrieval Master ingests · Analyst reasons · Checker audits · Critic validates · Finalizer renders
